run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T22:13:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real 5xx/504 error spans in frontend-proxy: its error-span rate was 0 at the sampled points 22:09:37 and 22:11:37, then 0.53/s at 22:13:37 and 0.99-1.17/s from 22:15:37 through 22:21:37, and every one of those error spans is the operation "ingress" (http.status_code 504, duration ~15.0 s = the proxy's upstream timeout). The errors trace down a single path: frontend-proxy -> frontend /api/cart (HTTP 500) -> frontend client spans grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and /AddItem (rpc.grpc.status_code 9) -> cart server spans POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and /AddItem failing with Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis ... cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected()"). The cart pod's own logs show "Connection failed. Disposing the object" at 22:11:39.94 and then repeated "Wasn't able to connect to redis" + error lines from 22:13:56 until 22:20:13; the failing cart spans carried durations of 397-480 s, i.e. requests were queued behind a failing redis connection rather than failing fast. So the deepest observed failure is cart's inability to talk to its redis dependency valkey-cart (VALKEY_ADDR=valkey-cart:6379). I investigated the dependency: valkey-cart-58df56c79c-bf4lr is Running and Ready with restartCount 0, its Service has a ready endpoint (100.96.2.228:6379), both objects are on the same node, no node has memory/disk/PID pressure, and its own container usage stays far below its limits (peak 5.7MB of 10Mi memory, 0.0017-0.0036 cores of 10m CPU, 2-6% CFS throttling) - so there is no evidence that valkey-cart crashed, was evicted or was OOM-killed. What I could not establish from the evidence is the trigger that broke the cart->valkey-cart connection at 22:11:39: cart's container CPU usage and 85-93% CFS throttling rose only after that first connection failure (baseline 0.008-0.011 cores and 17-27% throttling), the flagd fault flags (including cartFailure) read "off", and no chaos tooling is installed in the cluster. Hypotheses that remain open, each separately listed, are cart-side CPU starvation at its 45m limit, a transiently unresponsive valkey-cart (its INFO-derived counters stopped advancing from ~22:12 while still being reported), and an unobserved network-level disruption between the two pods.

connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    dimensions:
    - default: otel-demo
      name: namespace
exporters:
  clickhouse:
    endpoint: http://clickhouse-clickhouse.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local:8123
    logs_table_name: otel_demo_logs
    password: ""
    traces_table_name: otel_demo_traces
    username: default
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch-master.opensearch.svc.cluster.local:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel-logs
    logs_index_time_format: yyyy-MM-dd
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector.opentelemetry-collectors.svc.cluster.local:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  nginx:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: http://image-provider:8081/status
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  postgresql:
    endpoint: postgresql:5432
    metrics:
      postgresql.blks_hit:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.blks_read:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.deadlocks:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_deleted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_fetched:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_inserted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_returned:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_updated:
        enabled: true
    password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
    tls:
      insecure: true
    username: root
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
    username: valkey
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - debug
      - prometheus
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - nginx
      - otlp
      - postgresql
      - redis
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - pull:
          exporter:
            prometheus:
